READING_COMPREHENSION.category: One World - Friends from Planet Nova
READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Kai is thirteen and his favourite colour is blue. His pet rabbit, Pip, is grey with yellow eyes. Kai's best friend is Zara. She is twelve, her hair is black and yellow, and she can fly. Their friend Max is thirteen. He is not very tall, but he is very strong. The three friends are from Planet Nova and they are all very different.

Ella meets her friends before school. It is her first basketball practice, so she is a little worried. The practice is at lunchtime, not after school. Later they meet Sam, who has a new laptop. Sam shows them a photo of his favourite basketball player. The player is American and his team is very successful. At the end, Ella discovers that today's practice is cancelled and the next practice is tomorrow.

questions.q: Is it Ella's first basketball practice?
Where is the basketball player from?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Scotland is part of the United Kingdom. English, Scots and Scottish Gaelic are official languages, and English is the main language. Edinburgh is the capital and is famous for its castle and festivals. Glasgow is much bigger and is well known for football, art and its port. Inverness is a smaller city in the Highlands. A famous traditional sports event takes place there every year.

questions.q: What is the capital of Scotland?
How many official languages are mentioned?
Which city is famous for football and its port?
What kind of event is connected with Inverness?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Harbour City is in the southeast of Australia. It is a large city with more than five million people. There is a famous opera house and a big bridge near the harbour. Every January there is an arts festival with music, theatre and many visitors. The city is busy, colourful and popular with tourists.

questions.q: What can visitors enjoy at the festival?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Hi, Mia! How are you? My new school is really nice. I'm in class 2B and I'm on the volleyball team. My parents and I are in our new house now. Our neighbours are friendly and my classmates are fun. My favourite subject is science, but our teacher's favourite subject is history! Write soon, Alex.

questions.q: Is Alex on a sports team?
